macros.name: academictitle
macros.doc: The \academictitle optional command enables to switch from 'grado' to 'título' for undergraduate programs requiring it.

macros.doc: The \university{university name} command allows you to customize the university name, which defaults to ’Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México’.
